name: Haibane ABe pastel
summary: Gentle early-digital TV in yoshitoshi ABe's designs: small grey wings and halos in a walled old-European town, restrained muted pastels and painterly earth-tone backgrounds.

traits.line: Thin, simple, clean light-weight lines with few interior lines.
traits.shading: Flat early-digital cel with minimal shadow; backgrounds softly painted.
traits.palette: Restrained, muted, desaturated pastels: dove grey, cream, faded green, wheat, pale sky blue; amber interiors; colour stays light even under grey skies.
traits.lighting: Diffuse overcast daylight, warm amber lamplight indoors, faint glow of halos.
traits.faces: Understated faces with medium eyes and soft features, short practical hair; small grey feathered wings and halos.
traits.backgrounds: Painterly walled town of brick and stone, fields and old buildings with dusty lived-in detail.
traits.texture: Soft-edged painterly backgrounds against flat early-digital character fills.

style_words: Early-2000s digital TV animation with a quiet painterly look: thin simple clean lines, flat minimal cel shading, restrained desaturated pastels of dove grey, cream, faded green and wheat, diffuse overcast daylight and warm amber lamplight, soft-edged painterly old-town backgrounds of brick and stone, as in Haibane Renmei (2002).

krea2.style: Early-2000s TV animation with a quiet painterly look, as in Haibane Renmei: thin simple clean lines, flat minimal cel shading, understated faces with medium eyes, restrained muted pastels of dove grey, cream, faded green and wheat, diffuse overcast light and amber lamplight, soft-edged painterly brick and stone backgrounds, matte surfaces.
krea2.recap: Rendered throughout as quiet painterly early-2000s TV animation in muted dove-grey and cream pastels.

flux3_klein.style: Early-2000s digital TV anime with a quiet painterly look: thin, simple, clean light-weight lines with few interior lines, understated faces with medium eyes and soft features, flat early-digital cel fills with minimal shadow, restrained desaturated pastel colour that stays light even in dark scenes, diffuse even light, soft-edged painterly backgrounds behind flat figures, a matte finish.
flux3_klein.recap: Dove grey and cream fill the sky and the walls, faded green and wheat fill the ground, pale grey-blue sits in the shadow fills, amber appears only in lamp, candle and window light, and every garment keeps its own stated colour in a lighter muted tint.

qwen_image_2_1.style: The image is an early-2000s digital TV animation frame with a quiet painterly look, with thin, simple, clean light-weight lines and few interior lines, flat early-digital cel fills with minimal shadow, and soft-edged painterly backgrounds with dusty lived-in detail, depicting a scene from a Gothic Victorian novel in a palette of restrained desaturated dove grey, cream, faded green, wheat and pale sky blue, with warm amber lamplight.
qwen_image_2_1.recap: The overall composition holds its forms in a quiet, static arrangement under diffuse light, the colour staying light even in shadow, in a gentle, melancholy mood, keeps to a palette of restrained desaturated dove grey, cream, faded green, wheat and pale sky blue, with warm amber lamplight, and reads throughout as an early-2000s digital TV animation frame with a quiet painterly look, with thin, simple, clean light-weight lines and few interior lines, flat early-digital cel fills with minimal shadow, and soft-edged painterly backgrounds with dusty lived-in detail.
